rows.title: Close-Up 1989, directed by Abbas Kiarostami | Film review
rows.dek_lead: It's enormously intelligent stuff, witty, poignant and thoroughly engrossing, and ends with one of the sharpest, funniest deconstructions of film form ever shot. Absolutely wonderful.
